conviction_note: Nothing sourced decides this print. The period was not pre-released this year, unlike Q3-25's trading update, so the move scale stays near the 7% new-numbers base, nudged to 8 for thin turnover and a history with -23%/-29% tails. The sign is close to a coin flip: an open refinancing with a covenant waiver already granted for 30 September, fewer maritime deliveries left for H2 and the first-of-kind commissioning risk lean slightly negative; a very easy y/y comparison (Q3-25 adj. EBITDA -28.5m), a Food-segment review that is overdue, and insiders/new holders who bought at NOK 2.30-2.32 lean the other way. p_up 46 x 8 gives -0.64, close to the -0.9 sum of the findings and with the same sign.

already_public.what: Q2-26: revenue NOK 253m, adj. EBITDA NOK 32m (12.8%); backlog NOK 1.6bn; covenant breach at 30 June waived; refinancing targeted 'during Q3'; 7 of 11 maritime vessel deliveries done in H1
Refinancing phase 1: DNB facilities extended to 31 Dec 2027, waiver of certain covenant requirements as of 30 Sep 2026, phase 2 (long-term structure, covenants) expected in Q4 2026
Q3 order intake disclosed piecemeal: EUR 6.4m (2 Jul) and EUR 7.2m (8 Jul) cruise orders; Q4: EUR 7.7m firm + EUR 13.1m options (23 Oct)

new_in_release.expect: Q3 revenue and EBITDA likely below Q2's NOK 253m / 32m because only 4 of 11 maritime deliveries remained for H2 and the CEO warned not every quarter would set records. Far above Q3-25 (rev 214m, adj. EBITDA -28.5m) y/y. Net: unknown sign against an unsourced bar
Refinancing phase 2 status (promised Q4 2026): completion with covenant reset would be positive; any equity component or slippage negative. Unknown

Q3 should carry the large customer payment that slipped from June to July (company-stated), so NIBD and liquidity likely improve q/q. The pre-emptive 30-Sep covenant waiver tempers this. Mildly positive
Food-segment strategic review update, promised for Q3 2026 and not yet published. Direction unknown; a sale would help liquidity
Follum / Rhode Island commissioning status and whether delays stay within contingency. Tail risk negative
Vow gives no numeric guidance; qualitative outlook likely reiterated

bar: unsourced. No consensus is retrievable (Yahoo quoteSummary empty, analyst_count null; one undated Pareto Hold/NOK 7 on TipRanks https://www.tipranks.com/news/the-fly/vow-asa-downgraded-to-hold-from-buy-at-pareto). findings.finding: Refinancing is open: Q2 promised to conclude it 'during Q3', but on 29 Sep it was split into two phases, with a waiver of covenant requirements as of 30 Sep 2026 and phase 2 (long-term structure and covenants) expected in Q4. The Q3 report is the first scheduled update, against cash at hand of NOK 13.8m and a 21.5% equity ratio at 30 June.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Covenant/liquidity news has hit this name: the Oct-2025 trading update fell -13.2% and the Dec-2024 rights issue -10.7%/-4.3%. The 29 Sep 2026 refinancing update came after a +33% run from 2.48 to 3.30 and the stock drifted to ~2.70 afterwards.
findings.why_not_priced: The waiver itself is public and partly priced: the stock gave back the September spike. What is not priced is the phase-2 terms. There is no consensus and no preview. If the market priced a refinancing with an equity component, the stock would trade near or below the August NOK 2.30 placing, which it does not.
findings.independence: The Q2 report (https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=680139) shows the slippage from 'during Q3' and the covenant breach at 30 June; same issuer, different document

findings.finding: Maritime delivery phasing: 7 of 11 vessel deliveries for 2026 were done in H1, so only 4 remain for H2, and the CEO wrote 'I do not expect every quarter to set new records'. Q3 revenue and EBITDA likely step down from Q2's NOK 253m / 32m, while still far above Q3-25's NOK 214m / -28.5m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The last two quarterly prints on improving maritime results moved +10.25% (Q1-26) and +1.69% (Q2-26); Q3-25 moved +9.6% after a trading update had pre-warned.
findings.why_not_priced: The company itself flagged lumpiness, so the slowdown is inside its own guide and sized toward 0. With no published consensus the market's bar is invisible. A sell-off on a lower q/q print would show only if holders anchored on Q2.
findings.independence: Q3 order flow from the 2 Jul and 8 Jul releases is equipment for 2027+ deliveries and does not lift Q3 revenue (https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=684749 for the same pattern). Weak.

findings.finding: The Food-segment strategic review, promised in the Q2 report for 'an update expected in Q3 2026', has produced no NewsWeb announcement through 17 Nov. The Q3 report is the likely carrier, and a divestment would bring cash to a liquidity-stretched group.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior Vow divestment to measure. The Feb-2026 strategy-revision print moved -3.3%.
findings.why_not_priced: No wire item or press piece mentions the overdue update. A priced divestment would show as a rumour or as the stock holding its September highs; it did not.
findings.independence: The NewsWeb issuer list for 2026-05-01 to 2026-11-18 (https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/list?issuer=VOW&fromDate=2026-05-01&toDate=2026-11-18) carries no Food-segment release

findings.finding: Cancellation rights on vessels 3 and 4 of the EUR 27m February order (about EUR 13.5m) expired on 30.09.2026, and no MAR announcement of a cancellation followed. The order most likely firmed, and the Q3 backlog should confirm it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Order announcements are usually low-impact intraday; no measured reaction to a cancellation.
findings.why_not_priced: Nobody reported the expiry. Firming adds nothing new to a backlog the market already counts, so the upside is small; a cancellation would be the unpriced negative, and the absence of disclosure makes it unlikely.
findings.independence: The NewsWeb issuer list since May shows no cancellation notice (https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/list?issuer=VOW&fromDate=2026-05-01&toDate=2026-11-18)

findings.finding: Industrial Solutions: Follum and Rhode Island, both first-of-their-kind, hit technical challenges during commissioning that 'will affect the timeline for completion'. Delays are 'currently within the contingency provisions', so any overrun in Q3 is a tail risk on the segment that produced this name's worst reactions.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Industrial-segment surprises: H1-24 results -28.9%, FY23 presentation -23.4%, Oct-2025 trading update on negative Industrial revenue -13.2%, Jan-2026 impairment warning.
findings.why_not_priced: Public as a risk, not as an outcome. This year there was no profit warning or trading update, unlike October 2025. Since Nordic issuers must pre-warn a material miss, that silence lowers the probability. Net of a maritime business now carrying the group, the finding stays small with a fat left tail.
findings.independence: The Jan-2026 impairment notice (headline in https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/list?issuer=VOW&fromDate=2025-09-01&toDate=2026-04-30, msg 664306) shows the segment's history; same issuer

findings.finding: Ownership turned over at NOK 2.30-2.32 in August: lender-shareholder DNB placed 7.4% at 2.30, AS Audley built 8.97%, and the chairman bought 50k shares at 2.32. A DNB overhang left the register, insiders are buying, and the stock sits about 16% above those prices.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No measured reaction to the placing itself; the stock rose from 2.3x to 2.48 by mid-September.

baseline_tension: Mostly consistent with the lean: priced_lean +0.5 comes from a -9.9% 20d run-up. My mild negative lean slightly cuts against it, but at p_up 46 the disagreement is small.

lessons_applied: 'Financing is a question' and 'already told is worth 0': the refinancing finding moved from -0.8 to -0.6, because the waiver is public and the money refinances existing debt rather than signalling a new hole
'A finding inside what the company guided goes toward 0': the maritime phasing finding moved from -0.5 to -0.3 (the CEO pre-warned lumpiness)
'Too small about the move': abs_move_pct moved from 7.5 to 8.0, because the period was not pre-released and the history has -23%/-29% tails; p_up unchanged at 46
